name: comp-596
title: Nav Switch Header
blurb: Status navbar with badges and animated power toggle.
description: Header with nav tabs, online/uptime/latency badges, and animated power on/off toggle (motion-based state switch).
use_when: DevOps or infrastructure dashboards showing system status and control.
avoid_when: User-facing interfaces; status badges are for monitoring only.
a11y: Nav tabs keyboard-navigable. Badges are decorative (aria-hidden). Power toggle is semantic switch with aria-label.
